title: Don Albert band records: personnel, growl trumpet and arrangers
summary: Playing the Don Albert records, Alcorn recalls that all the sides were made in one session, who played in the band, the growl trumpeter, and Geechee Robinson's arrangement; Billy Douglas is praised as a trumpeter.
